title: formencoder

build.macos:
./formencoder install
./formencoder install-desktop
python setup/install_tools.py --stage --keep-going
./formencoder desktop build $FORMCOMPILER_CONFIG_ARG
build.linux:
./formencoder install
./formencoder install-desktop
python setup/install_tools.py --stage --keep-going
./formencoder desktop build $FORMCOMPILER_CONFIG_ARG
build.windows:
call formencoder.bat install
call formencoder.bat install-desktop
python setup\install_tools.py --stage --keep-going
call formencoder.bat desktop build %FORMCOMPILER_CONFIG_ARG%

post_build.macos:
ls src-tauri/tools > "delivery-tools-$FORMCOMPILER_PLATFORM.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "delivery tools staged: $(tr '\n' ' ' < "delivery-tools-$FORMCOMPILER_PLATFORM.txt")"
post_build.linux:
ls src-tauri/tools > "delivery-tools-$FORMCOMPILER_PLATFORM.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "delivery tools staged: $(tr '\n' ' ' < "delivery-tools-$FORMCOMPILER_PLATFORM.txt")"
post_build.windows:
ls src-tauri/tools > "delivery-tools-$FORMCOMPILER_PLATFORM.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "delivery tools staged: $(tr '\n' ' ' < "delivery-tools-$FORMCOMPILER_PLATFORM.txt")"

assets:
APP=app
[ -d "$APP/src-tauri" ] || APP=.
python3 - "$APP" "$DIST" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, sys, urllib.request
app, dist = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
src = json.load(open(app + '/src-tauri/binaries/ffmpeg-licence.json'))['source']['ffmpeg']
name = dist + '/' + src['url'].rsplit('/', 1)[1]
urllib.request.urlretrieve(src['url'], name)
digest = hashlib.sha256(open(name, 'rb').read()).hexdigest()
assert digest == src['sha256'], (digest, src['sha256'])
print('attached', name, digest)
lame = dist + '/lame-3.100.tar.gz'
urllib.request.urlretrieve('https://downloads.sourceforge.net/project/lame/lame/3.100/lame-3.100.tar.gz', lame)
digest = hashlib.sha256(open(lame, 'rb').read()).hexdigest()
assert digest == 'ddfe36cab873794038ae2c1210557ad34857a4b6bdc515785d1da9e175b1da1e', digest
print('attached', lame, digest)
PY
cp "$APP/src-tauri/binaries/LGPL-2.1.txt" "$APP/src-tauri/binaries/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt" "$APP/src-tauri/binaries/ffmpeg-licence.json" "$DIST/"

catalog.name: FormEncoder
catalog.summary: Convert, compress and export media in batches, with presets.

notes_for_owner: The LGPL source offer (the FFmpeg source tarball, checked against its pinned SHA-256, plus LGPL-2.1.txt, THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt and ffmpeg-licence.json) is produced by the assets script, which reads src-tauri/binaries/ffmpeg-licence.json from the app checkout (it looks in app/ and falls back to the working directory). The same script attaches the LAME 3.100 source tarball, checked against its pinned SHA-256, as LAME's LGPL source offer. Check the first release carries all five files. Because install_tools.py runs with --keep-going, a tool that fails to build is left out; each platform's post-build writes delivery-tools-PLATFORM.txt listing what was staged in src-tauri/tools, and the artifacts list (the default bundle globs plus that file) attaches it to the release. Build mode is commands so install_tools.py --stage --keep-going runs after install and after the MSVC environment is on PATH (nmake for LAME), the old order; a setup entry would run before the MSVC step. macOS and Linux pass $FORMCOMPILER_CONFIG_ARG to ./formencoder desktop build. Windows passes %FORMCOMPILER_CONFIG_ARG% to formencoder.bat desktop build (formencoder 0.5.0 and later), so Windows builds make updater artifacts too. On macOS, setup/sign_resources.py signs every Mach-O staged in src-tauri/tools and src-tauri/ffmpeg w/ the Developer ID, hardened runtime and a timestamp before tauri build, because Tauri does not sign resources; on Windows those tools stay unsigned inside the installer. The updater public key in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json is still empty, so the app skips update checks until a key pair is made and TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY is set in formcompiler.
